en: This kind of reminds me of the day I set out on Route 1...
OK, here's how it works. The Pokédex fills in by itself whenever you meet a Pokémon.
And when you catch one, it records even more about it! So, watch closely. I'll catch one now.
Phew! I did it! OK, the important part: weaken a wild Pokémon first, then throw a Poké Ball.
If it's healthy it'll just break out. A tired Pokémon is much easier to catch!
You're taking that Town Map down to your friend, right? Floccesy Town is straight down this road.
Bye for now! Meet lots of Pokémon, and catch lots of them, OK?
The name's Alder! I go where the wind takes me, and I tell everyone I meet how good it is to walk with Pokémon.
And who might you be? {player}, from Aspertia City! Ha! Up the hill, eh?
Your {starter} is a fine-looking Pokémon. But you're not quite a seasoned Trainer yet, are you?
Right! I'll give you a little training. Follow me to Floccesy Town!
Hm? Out walking with a Pokémon? Good, good! There's no better way to spend a day.
Weaken it first, then throw the ball! You can do it!
